card: This PR replaces the custom WalletLogPrintf() logging wrapper across wallet files with Bitcoin Core standard level-based logging macros (LogInfo, LogWarning, LogError). It introduces a WalletLogContext class so wallet-name prefixes remain intact while enabling proper severity level filtering. Additionally, it fixes -logsourcelocations for wallet code by attributing messages to actual call sites rather than the helper definition. The pull request is based on logging macro refactors in #34778 and #29256.
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto the latest versions of base PRs #34778 and #29256, and added a temporary commit adjusting CI fetch depth for testing each commit.
evidence: Author's PR description: "The new logging macros introduced in #28318 weren't previously useful in wallet code because wallet code prefixes most log messages with the wallet names to be able to distinguish log output from multiple wallets."
Author's PR description: "This change makes `-logsourcelocations` usable with wallet code because it logs actual source locations instead of the `WalletLogPrintf()` location."
problem: Wallet log messages previously routed through `WalletLogPrintf()` to prepend wallet names, forcing all wallet messages to log at info level and making `-logsourcelocations` unhelpful by pointing every line to the header helper definition rather than the actual call site.

risk.why: The changes only modify logging statements and log context formatting within the wallet subsystem without altering business logic or database operations.

scope_notes: This PR is stacked on top of #34778 and #29256; only the top two wallet-specific commits (plus a temporary CI fetch-depth commit) belong strictly to this pull request.
summary: Replaces the custom `WalletLogPrintf()` wrapper across the wallet subsystem with standard level-based logging macros (`LogInfo()`, `LogWarning()`, `LogError()`). It introduces `WalletLogContext` (derived from `util::log::Context`) to preserve wallet-name prefixes while allowing callers to log with appropriate severity levels. This also ensures that `-logsourcelocations` points directly to the calling site rather than the inline helper.
